Please open a Discussion to get approval for this feature request first, as described in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md). The [progress docs](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/progress.rst) describe adding custom columns by subclassing `ProgressColumn`; `TaskProgressColumn(show_speed=True)` displays iteration speed when the total is unknown, and `TransferSpeedColumn` is for byte-based speeds.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
